items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I'm working down there with a local guy, Innocent Smith and Little Ruth Crowder; Little Sax Crowder had a four-piece group... And I'm working with them

ctx.x: Yeah, I worked with Stuff. But first, I worked back -- Buster was working at a place called Lips Lower Level, which turned out to be the Blue Note; one of the top nightclubs. But I came back to Chicago, and I'm working down there with a local guy, Innocent Smith and Little Ruth Crowder;
Little Sax Crowder had a four-piece group; a tenor, trumpet, bass and piano. And I'm working with them ...
